## Scenarios

This section describes the four scenarios that were exercised and presents the result of each one, so that the reader can follow what was checked and in which order.

In the first scenario the tester opened the application, selected the standard product and read the resulting rate from the summary panel. The rate shown was 2.145000, which is reported to six decimal places, and it matched the expected value, so this scenario passed.

In the second scenario the tester repeated the same navigation with the promotional product selected instead. The rate shown was 1.980000, again reported to six decimal places, and it matched the expected value, so this scenario passed as well.

In the third scenario the tester changed the term from twelve months to twenty-four months and read the rate a further time. The rate shown was 2.310000, reported to six decimal places, and it matched the expected value, so this scenario passed.

In the fourth and final scenario the tester reopened the saved case from the overview and confirmed that the stored rate had not moved. The rate shown was 2.310000, once more reported to six decimal places, and it matched the expected value, so this scenario passed too.
